title: Spec Workbench
description: Manage feature designs, optional clickable prototypes, and vertical-slice tickets with live visible sessions, interactive Q&A, one-click implementation, and feature/ticket review.

en.title: Spec Workbench
en.description: Manage feature designs, optional clickable prototypes, and vertical-slice tickets with live visible sessions, interactive Q&A, one-click implementation, and feature/ticket review.

zh-CN.title: 方案工作台
zh-CN.description: 专注需求设计、工单与可选原型管理：需求倒序追踪、可视化提问与跨会话上下文回复、自动创建可见会话实时联动、按需/按工单实现与评审。

params.label: TDD Enforcement
params.description: How strictly builder sessions follow red-green TDD when implementing tickets.

zh-CN.label: 严格（必须先写失败测试）
TDD 严格程度
zh-CN.description: 按工单实现时要求遵循先红后绿 TDD 流程的严格程度。

params.label: Prompt Auto Ticket Cutting
params.description: Instruct design grilling sessions to synthesize and confirm design.html via spec-workbench-to-design and then proceed to cut tickets with spec-workbench-to-tickets.

zh-CN.label: 设计确认后自动推进切工单
zh-CN.description: 在需求拷问与设计会话中，指示 Agent 在答疑完成后先通过 spec-workbench-to-design 生成并确认设计，再自动推进切工单。

params.label: Project Design & Review Rules
params.description: Additional architectural or coding guidelines appended to design, implement, and review sessions.
params.placeholder: e.g. Prefer vertical slices, keep API backward compatible

zh-CN.label: 项目设计与评审补充约束
zh-CN.description: 自动附加到方案设计、切工单、实现与代码评审会话指令中的项目约定。
zh-CN.placeholder: 例如：优先垂直切片拆分；保持对外 API 向后兼容
